name: archives_library_search
description: Search the scientific reference library catalogue of the National Archives of Georgia (Koha ILS) by keyword, title, author or subject. Returns a true result total plus the page of records, each with its permanent biblionumber and catalogue URL. Records are Georgian-language with parallel Latin titles where the record has one. Pages 20 at a time via offset.

query.description: Search terms. Georgian or Latin script both work.

index.description: Which index to search: keyword (default), title, author, subject.

offset.description: Zero-based record offset for paging; the page size is 20. Pass 20 for the second page.

name: archives_library_record
description: Fetch one catalogue record from the National Archives of Georgia reference library by its biblionumber (the id archives_library_search returns), as parsed MARC. Returns the full MARC field/subfield structure plus a flattened summary of title, authors, imprint, ISBN, languages and physical description.

biblionumber.description: Koha biblionumber, e.g. "4035". Returned as `biblionumber` by archives_library_search.

name: archives_fonds_browse
description: Browse the fonds register of the National Archives of Georgia — roughly 14,650 fonds across 586 pages, 25 per page. Each row gives the holding regional archive, the archive name, the fond number, the fond name, the historical names the fond carried with their date ranges, and the inclusive dates of its administrative and personnel records. Browse only: the register has no query API.

page.description: Page number, 1-586. 25 fonds per page. Defaults to 1.

name: archives_film_search
description: Search the Georgian national film catalogue (kinokatalogi, National Archives of Georgia) — 652 newsreels, documentaries and features. Filter by title with `name`; returns each film with its release year, genre, and its directors and camera operators as {id, name} objects carrying the catalogue's own person ids. Paginates 15 at a time with a true total.

name.description: Title substring to filter on, e.g. "თბილისი". Omit to list the whole catalogue. This is the only filter the upstream honours — it silently ignores any other parameter and returns everything.

page.description: Page number, 15 films per page. Defaults to 1.

locale.description: Interface locale for the returned labels: ka (default) or en.
